kind: independent offline airborne episode integrity, timing, qualification and public-only replay audit

assessment.category_scope: Selected generator/bus and blue quantity/pressure observations; not whole-aircraft health

ledger.details: Observed quantity fell at least 0.5 raw model units from its reference across advancing readings. This does not identify a leak or its initiating cause.
Quantity returned near the original reference. Native automatic restoration is a possible explanation; physical repair is not established.

limits: Offline audit establishes recorded integrity, timing and replay; not real-aircraft fidelity or diagnostic accuracy.
Observed quantity, pressure, electrical and flight ranges are reported without forcing predicted outcomes.
Exact internal pre-write callback instant is not serialized; completed enable before receipt-based expiry is a conservative recorded check.
Per-sample post-fault controller evaluation instants are not separately serialized; timing checks use recorded receipts and phase bounds.
Native values are non-atomic model properties; pressure retention or stable flight does not establish actuator capability.
